newsitem.title: UK: Turnover slow in Europe raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Turnover slow in Europe raw cotton.

text.p: Raw cotton turnover seems generally slow in the absence of significant price developments.
Spinners in Europe are presumed to need substantial amounts to meet yarn production commitments in the summer and early autumn.

Some traders believe these needs will be hard to fill, citing their view that Central Asian styles are likely to be less available as the year progresses while alternative origins, including US cottons, are relatively few and expensive.
